import urllib.request, json, ssl, time
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(); ctx.check_hostname=False; ctx.verify_mode=ssl.CERT_NONE
RENDER_KEY="rnd_1H0XCquMZQTRyAnHgbEv8dVWYPVs"
SERVICE_ID="srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0"

# Trigger deploy with correct clearCache value
print("=== Triggering redeploy ===")
body = json.dumps({"clearCache": "do_not_clear"}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request(
    f"https://api.render.com/v1/services/{SERVICE_ID}/deploys",
    data=body,
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RENDER_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"},
    method="POST"
)
deploy_id = ""
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=30) as r:
        deploy = json.loads(r.read().decode())
        deploy_id = deploy.get("id","")
        print(f"  Deploy triggered: id={deploy_id} status={deploy.get('status','?')}")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print(f"  HTTP {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  Error: {e}")

# Poll for completion
print(f"\n=== Polling deploy {deploy_id[:25]} ===")
for i in range(24):  # 24 x 15s = 6 min max
    time.sleep(15)
    try:
        req2 = urllib.request.Request(
            f"https://api.render.com/v1/services/{SERVICE_ID}/deploys/{deploy_id}" if deploy_id else
            f"https://api.render.com/v1/services/{SERVICE_ID}/deploys?limit=1",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RENDER_KEY}", "Accept": "application/json"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, context=ctx, timeout=15) as r:
            data = json.loads(r.read().decode())
            if isinstance(data, list): data = data[0] if data else {}
            status = data.get("status","?")
            finished = data.get("finishedAt")
            print(f"  [{i+1}/24] status={status} finishedAt={finished}")
            if status == "live":
                print("  >>> Deploy LIVE!")
                break
            if status in ("failed","cancelled"):
                print(f"  >>> Deploy {status}!")
                break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  [{i+1}/24] Error: {e}")

# Verify health after deploy
print("\n=== Post-deploy health check ===")
try:
    req3 = urllib.request.Request("https://api.ivxholding.com/health", headers={"User-Agent":"IVX-QA"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req3, context=ctx, timeout=30) as r:
        h = json.loads(r.read().decode())
        print(f"  status: {h.get('status')}")
        print(f"  commit: {h.get('commit','')[:12]}")
        print(f"  bootTime: {h.get('bootTime')}")
        diag = h.get("ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalQA")
        if diag:
            print(f"  ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalQA: FOUND")
            print(f"    deployedSha: {diag.get('deployedSha','')[:12]}")
            print(f"    aiProviderReady: {diag.get('aiProviderReady')}")
        
        pv = h.get("ivxSeniorDeveloperProviderVerification", {})
        print(f"  providerVerification.providerReady: {pv.get('providerReady')}")
        print(f"  providerVerification.credentialValid: {pv.get('credentialValid')}")
        print(f"  providerVerification.keyPrefix: {pv.get('keyPrefix')}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  Error: {e}")
PYEOF
